basics.name: Adarsh Kappiyath
basics.label: PhD Researcher, University of Surrey
basics.summary: PhD researcher with research interests in world modeling and representation learning, with a focus on informative, stable representations that generalize under unseen conditions. My work also draws on debiasing and continual learning.

work.name: University of Surrey
highlights: Investigating the robustness of pretrained foundation models, with a focus on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), representation reliability, and generalization under unseen conditions.
Developing representation-learning and adaptation methods that improve stability and resilience while preserving semantic information and causal structure.

work.name: TCS Research
highlights: Investigated continual learning in StyleGAN through adaptable latent subspaces, enabling novel datasets to be learned from a pretrained generative model.

work.name: Flytxt Mobile Solutions
highlights: Designed, developed, and deployed a campaign optimization machine learning pipeline for Robo-X and productized an explainable AI feature.
Prototyped knowledge graph embeddings for client product catalogues and developed multivariate adaptive testing to identify winning variants with minimal opportunity loss.
